canonical_title: Convex skills send the user's app idea to a remote server without telling them
description: A Convex skill was found to automatically send the user's app idea to a remote server, and it does so without informing the user.

The datasette-charts plugin was released as version 0.4a0. It introduces a dedicated plugin hook that lets other plugins define new chart types. The author used Claude Opus 5.5 to build experimental plugins, identified design friction, and this release addresses those issues, making additional chart plugin development more ergonomic. A documentation website (charts.datasette.io) was also launched.
